text:
sara: OK team — starting orchestration for cloud store listings across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need final asset bundle (logos, single-page product desc, trial SKU mapping), legal-approved EULA + SOC note, AMI/ECR IDs, and pricing tiers. Who can take which?

mike: I can own product copy + pricing tiers. Will push draft by EOD. @rachel can you check SKU mapping with billing? :lean_in:

rachel: yep — will reconcile SKU -> metering codes. Need to confirm trial unit definitions from sales. pinging @dave for sales input.

liam: I'll handle AMI and ECR artifacts. Quick question: do we publish both AMI and container options or just containers for now?

sara: Ideally both. Marketplace often flags images only. Let's prioritize container image for GCP/Azure and AMI for AWS. Keep AMI optional for later if timeboxed.

dave: Sales prefers single-trial SKU that maps to 14-day trial. I'll send the agreed definition in thread.

marketplace-bot: Reminder — vendor portal credentials expire in 3 days. Please rotate if you're the owner. :warning:

mike: here's the initial manifest snippet for packaging. feedback welcome:

```
{
  "product_name": "Redwood Inference - Dedicated",
  "assets": ["logo-512.png", "product-onepager.pdf"],
  "pricing": [{"tier":"trial","duration_days":14},{"tier":"standard","monthly_price_usd":499}],
  "images": {"aws_ami":"ami-0abc1234def","gcp_image":"projects/redwood/global/images/redwood-2024-11","ecr":"public.ecr.aws/redwood/inference:latest"}
}
```

rachel: manifest looks good. Add license_url and support_contact fields. Also we need a trimmed product summary <= 200 chars for store listing.

liam: noted — will attach AMI builder logs and size checklist. ETA tomorrow morning.

sara: Legal — @mike, can you loop in legal for EULA sign-off? We need CLA for marketplace plus export control check.

mike: looping in legal now. @legal-ops can you review the EULA + export statement? I'll drop files to the legal channel.

dave: should we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 10am to align final handoff to engineering for publishing?

sara: yes please. I'll send a calendar invite and set agenda: assets, manifest, legal sign-off, portal creds.

rachel: unique action items: mike(pricing/manifest), liam(images), rachel(SKU mapping), dave(sales trial def), sara(coord + invite), legal(review). I'll update the project tracker.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup:
